title: Maintain whole change review standing and applicability
statement: The Review and verification Module shall maintain attributable current review standing, unresolved findings and applicable support within one whole-change gate, without requiring permanent storage of superseded assessment attempts.

what.problem: The SR-082 obligation crosses guidance, governance or publication boundaries; an unowned contribution can make a locally valid step appear sufficient for the whole workflow.
what.desired_outcome: Keep advisory feedback distinct from formal approval, retain enough assessed basis for current reliance, and support proportionate reassessment.

why.rationale: MOD-007 owns the behavior or state needed for this contribution; separating it preserves one accountable owner while allowing the parent SR to compose several contributors.

stakeholders: Participants relying on Review and verification
Authors, reviewers and project decision owners

conditions: When the selected requirement-first workflow exercises SR-082 or reassesses its affected basis.

contexts: The MOD-007 responsibility boundary and its declared logical Interfaces.

how.approach: Apply the allocated criteria through the constrained Functions and explicit contract inputs/outcomes; preserve actual actor decisions, subject identity and known limitations.

how_much.scope: This allocated contribution to SR-082; other contributors, independent assessment, physical recording implementation and product activation remain distinct.

acceptance_criteria: Keep advisory feedback distinct from formal approval, retain enough assessed basis for current reliance, and support proportionate reassessment.

Assess changes and affected interactions proportionately. Permit explicit justified applicability continuation after harmless edits without a new Review; material corrections require independent reassessment and unknown impact remains unresolved. Retain whole-change adequacy, cumulative change visibility and original judgment meanings.
Keep Verify distinct; engineering defects require owned correction and affected review, while unchanged-subject evidence retries do not automatically restart review.
assumptions: The selected project contract, scope and required counterpart contributions are identifiable; absence is reported rather than inferred.
constraints: This draft allocation neither activates replacement runtime contracts nor proves implementation or satisfaction.

sources.basis: Draft integrated design from the accepted requirement-first basis. This defines target responsibility and cooperation, not installed capability, design approval, runtime evidence or SQLite adoption.

User-directed refinement of review applicability after subsequent edits: preserve original judgments, allow justified harmless-change continuation and independently reassess material effects. Author-assessed design/requirement refinement only; no runtime adoption or independent approval is claimed.
User-selected current handoff and selective retention refinement. Reuse existing identity and responsibility; no runtime adoption or independent approval is asserted.
